item.title: Oil: Supply risks keep prices elevated – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Bank’s Danske Research Team notes that Oil remains supported near USD 100 as Middle East tensions and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz weigh on supply and sentiment.

item.title: US: Trade investigations sustain policy uncertainty – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s FX & Commodity Analyst Volkmar Baur highlights that new US Section 301 investigations are designed to replace recently invalidated Section 122 tariffs and avoid their July expiry.

item.title: INR: Rupee seen as key shock absorber – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered’s Anubhuti Sahay and Saurav Anand assess India’s macro outlook as Middle East tensions raise risks for Oil and global rates.

item.title: S&P 500 looking like it has made a topping pattern
item.description: The weakness hasn’t yet followed through with massive selling, but price action shows we’re now trading below excellent support and look poised to test 6636/6629. This area is crucial in the coming days.

item.title: AUD: RBA hike risk and Oil exposure support currency – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Head of Research Derek Halpenny argues the Australian Dollar has benefited from expectations of further RBA tightening and a positive terms-of-trade impulse from higher energy prices.

item.title: EUR/USD: Under pressure on energy shock – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes EUR/USD has slipped below 1.1500 as higher Dollar-denominated energy costs hurt most European corporates.

item.title: USD: Haven bid persists on Strait risks – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes that the Dollar is supported as markets focus on risks to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and higher Oil prices. With Brent above $100 and stagflation concerns weighing on bonds and stocks, USD is near cyclical highs.
